641:t_017:24.en:
$$アスカ$$
「By the pole, do you mean the South Pole or the North Pole!?」

641:t_017:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Something is emerging from the surface at $$蒼の地球$$'s South Pole!」

641:t_018:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Are you kidding me!? Three of those monsters just showed up!」

641:t_018:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To think things like those were buried at the South Pole!」

641:t_018:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The $$エル・ミレニウム$$ were put to sleep until the day judgment would be passed on humanity.」

641:t_018:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Those three emissaries were sent to the pole on the day your ancestors landed on the moon.」

641:t_018:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Their very existence is proof of your power... the power of humanity's overseers!」

641:t_018:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Here's another present for you!」

641:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The black $$アンゲロイ$$ have shown up, too!」

641:t_019:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Its name is $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$... The $$アンゲロイ$$ used by $$サイデリアル$$ are mere imitations.」

641:t_019:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「So those crystal monsters and black $$アンゲロイ$$ are the $$御使い$$s' own forces!」

641:t_019:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As you know, their power is beyond comparison with the weapons given to $$サイデリアル$$.」

641:t_019:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Why are you explaining all that so smugly, $$アウストラリス$$?」

641:t_019:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$アウストラリス$$. If you seize the Earth species' four $$スフィア$$s, we will forgive your sin.」

641:t_019:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I am not $$アウストラリス$$...」

641:t_019:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am Dimensional General $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

641:t_019:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We take that as rebellion against us.」

641:t_019:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Such arrogance... Must I say it aloud for you to understand...?」

641:t_019:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am Dimensional General $$ヴィルダーク$$! I am the power that will destroy the fundamental calamity!」

641:t_019:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahaha! Thanks for all your hard work, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

641:t_019:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$立ち上がる射手$$ draws its power from defiance. Of course we knew that you, its bearer, only obeyed us on the surface.」

641:t_019:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And yet you let me do as I pleased, because you arrogantly assumed you would always win.」

641:t_020:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wait, $$ヴィルダーク$$! If we combine your power with ours...」

641:t_020:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't rely on me! Fight with your own power!」

641:t_020:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「One day, I will take your $$スフィア$$s, too. To destroy them...!」

641:t_021:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you're our enemy after all!」

641:t_021:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「But he knows his place.」

641:t_021:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「He knows he cannot defeat them with his current power.」

641:t_021:3.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$御使い$$s. Today, we merely came to see your faces.」

641:t_021:5.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「That vast sea of stars.」

641:t_021:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Let us settle things there! Let us end the True War that has spanned 120 million years!」

641:t_022:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A declaration of war! This is getting exciting!」

641:t_022:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But however much they struggle, they cannot set foot in our universe.」

641:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then let us return. To our universe... $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

641:t_023:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those bastards! They don't even give a damn about us!?」

641:t_023:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「As $$ハーデス$$ said before, we must be insignificant before the wars of gods against demons, and gods against gods.」

641:t_023:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「They think we're nothing! Then we'll just smash the parting gifts they left us!」

641:t_023:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So those crystal monsters are a system for destroying humans who refuse to obey them...!」

641:t_023:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「We don't even know if we can beat one, and now there are three...!」

641:t_023:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it! Now we can't even think about departing!」

641:t_023:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「The President has just given the signal of approval.」

641:t_023:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「So our worst-case scenario has already arrived...」

641:t_023:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hold the line for three minutes! Keep them pinned down here so they can't reach Earth!」

641:t_023:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If we can't defeat them in those three minutes...」

641:t_023:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「Right now, focus only on fighting! Otherwise, they'll kill us...!」

641:t_023:14.en:
$$桂$$
「Our hopeful departure turned into a battlefield of despair in an instant!」

641:t_023:15.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But we have to fight! If we stop here, nothing will change!」

641:t_024:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What are we gonna do!? If more of these show up after we head into the galaxy, humanity really will be wiped out!」

641:t_024:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We'll think about that later!」

641:t_025:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even if we beat these, if more show up after we head into the galaxy, humanity really will be wiped out!」

641:t_025:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We'll think about that later!」

641:t_026:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
「At this rate, forget departing... We could be annihilated...!」

641:t_026:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But if they break through us here, Earth will...!」

641:t_026:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$, the Earth Federation President has initiated the activation of $$スヴェル$$.」

641:t_026:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「You heard him, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

641:t_026:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All right...! All ships, gather around the Buster Machine! All units, follow them!」

641:t_026:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「There are still enemies out there! And yet...!」

641:t_026:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying we're going to abandon Earth and leave!?」

641:t_027:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$御使い$$s' forces are heading for Earth...!」

641:t_027:1.en:
$$シン$$
「At this rate, they'll break through the atmosphere!」

641:t_027:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All $$ＺＯＮＥ$$s and $$ラース・バビロン$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$ are operating normally!」

641:t_027:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Deployment of the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier '$$スヴェル$$' confirmed!」

641:t_028:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's... the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier...!」
